name: Crushing Crowd (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-01: Intro to the Year of Immortal Influence
description: The crowd rushes forward, risking a stampede as everyone tries to fnd a safe exit.
disable: DC 18 Diplomacy to calm the crowd, or DC 21 Intimidation or DC 21 Society to control the crowd's behavior
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the crowd moves 5 feet toward the exit in area A1, then crushes any creature in a 10ft Emanation, dealing (4d6) Bludgeoning Damage damage. All targets must attempt a Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes Prone.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, becomes prone, and is Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Lady Embersplitter announces that the victim has died

Effect The crowd begins moving around the bailey and deals (4d6) Bludgeoning Damage damage in a 10ft Emanation (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save), and then rolls initiative.
